stated_factor: Access to connectors not enabled
evidence_quote: Admins have not enabled Copilot connectors to CRM and ticketing systems pending security review.

stated_factor: Agents restricted to read-only suggestion mode
evidence_quote: Banks restrict agents to drafting suggestions; no agent may execute a payment without human sign-off.

stated_factor: Copilot surfaced documents employees should not see
evidence_quote: Early pilots exposed salary spreadsheets because SharePoint permissions had never been cleaned up.

stated_factor: Hard to justify the per-seat licence cost
evidence_quote: CFOs question paying $30 per user per month without measurable productivity gains.

stated_factor: Usage dropped sharply after the first month
evidence_quote: Weekly active usage fell by half after launch because employees did not know which tasks to use it for.

stated_factor: Too many pilots, none reach production
evidence_quote: Firms run dozens of disconnected agent pilots with no owner accountable for scaling them.

stated_factor: Hallucinated figures in claims settlement letters
evidence_quote: The insurer paused its claims agent after it generated incorrect settlement amounts in customer letters.

stated_factor: Prompt injection risk from browsing agents
evidence_quote: Security teams blocked web-browsing agents after red-team tests showed hidden instructions could exfiltrate data.

stated_factor: Integration with core banking mainframe is slow and costly
evidence_quote: Connecting onboarding agents to the COBOL core banking platform required 18 months of middleware work.

stated_factor: EU AI Act obligations for high-risk systems
evidence_quote: Companies delayed deployment until they could document conformity assessments required under the EU AI Act.

stated_factor: Clinicians fear liability for AI-drafted notes
evidence_quote: Physicians refuse to sign AI-generated clinical notes because accountability for errors is unclear.

stated_factor: EHR data is fragmented and poorly labelled
evidence_quote: Hospital systems hold patient data across incompatible records with inconsistent coding, limiting agent accuracy.

stated_factor: No executive sponsor or budget owner
evidence_quote: Initiatives stalled where no business executive owned the outcome or the budget.

stated_factor: Staff lack prompting skills and training
evidence_quote: Employees received a one-hour webinar and were left to work out effective prompts themselves.

stated_factor: Average handle time reduced by 30 percent
evidence_quote: Agent assist cut average handle time by 30% across the contact centre within six months.

stated_factor: Agent service accounts have excessive standing privileges
evidence_quote: Non-human identities for agents were granted broad admin rights, creating unacceptable blast radius.

stated_factor: Regulator requires explainability of automated credit decisions
evidence_quote: Lenders must explain adverse credit decisions, which opaque agent reasoning cannot yet support.

stated_factor: Plant floor OT systems lack APIs for agents
evidence_quote: Manufacturers' operational technology runs on proprietary controllers with no interfaces agents can call.

stated_factor: Supplier master data quality derails procurement agents
evidence_quote: Duplicate and outdated supplier records caused sourcing agents to recommend the wrong vendors at an automotive OEM.

stated_factor: Inconsistent answers to the same question erode trust
evidence_quote: Users stopped relying on the assistant after it gave different answers to identical policy questions.

stated_factor: Unclear how to measure productivity gains
evidence_quote: Most firms track licences assigned rather than outcomes, so value cannot be demonstrated.

stated_factor: Shadow AI use of consumer chatbots by employees
evidence_quote: Staff paste confidential documents into consumer chatbots because sanctioned tools are not available.

stated_factor: Data residency rules prevent sending citizen data to cloud models
evidence_quote: Government departments cannot process citizen records in model endpoints hosted outside national borders.

stated_factor: Union concerns about job displacement
evidence_quote: Public-sector unions opposed agent rollouts in benefits processing over fears of job losses.

stated_factor: Legacy grid management systems cannot expose real-time data
evidence_quote: Utilities' SCADA and outage systems cannot stream data to agents without major upgrades.

stated_factor: NERC CIP security requirements slow agent deployment
evidence_quote: Critical infrastructure protection standards require extensive review before any agent touches grid systems.

stated_factor: Centre of excellence with a prioritised use-case portfolio
evidence_quote: Leaders that funded a central team to prioritise use cases by value scaled twice as many agents.

stated_factor: Full audit trail of agent actions won risk committee approval
evidence_quote: Logging every agent action with replayable traces allowed the bank's risk committee to approve production use.

stated_factor: Token costs spiralled when agents looped
evidence_quote: A runaway agent loop generated a five-figure inference bill in a weekend at a SaaS provider.

stated_factor: Store associates distrusted inventory agent recommendations
evidence_quote: Retail store staff overrode replenishment agent suggestions they could not understand.

stated_factor: Network agents need access across siloed OSS/BSS systems
evidence_quote: Telcos' network operations agents cannot act because inventory and billing systems are siloed.

stated_factor: GxP validation requirements for AI tools
evidence_quote: Pharma companies must validate AI systems under GxP before use in regulated quality processes.
